messages:
Maria: reserving quiet slot 03:00 UTC tomorrow for a catalog ingest: calypso-lite v2 -> catalog. Owners: @Jonathan, @Lee. Need smoke owner, rollback plan, and who will monitor 03:00-04:00 UTC.
Jonathan: I can own smoke checks and initial validation. Will run perf/sanity scripts and watch traces.
Lee: I'll own rollback and can flip alias if needed. I'm on-call that window.
Nidhi: I'll be on alerts and can take metrics/latency post-smoke for 03:00-04:30. Ping me if anything spikes.
sre-bot: deploy scheduled: calypso-lite v2 ingest queued for 2025-06-02 03:00:00 UTC. Requester: Maria. Links: https://deploys.internal/reports/1755554321
Maria: thanks. Jonathan - quick checklist for smoke? keep it short so ops can follow.
Jonathan: smoke checklist:
1) run ingest dry-run: `scripts/ingest_dryrun.sh --model calypso-lite:v2`
2) run 100 sample queries via `tests/smoke/quick_qps.py --count 100`
3) verify tail latency p50/p99 against baseline (dashboard link)
4) confirm KV cache warmup metrics show >80% hit in 15m
5) sanity prompt checks for hallucination baseline

Lee: rollback plan:
- Disable new alias and re-pin previous model (calypso-lite:v1) -> `catalog pin calypso-lite@v1 --alias calypso`
- Re-run smoke quick checks to confirm revert
- If alias swap fails, scale down ingest job and escalate to infra on-call

Nidhi: I'll watch cost/throughput charts and set temporary alert threshold at +30% token/sec. If triggered, I'll notify and we can throttle.
Maria: perfect. two more asks: 1) can we add a tiny canary (5% traffic) first? 2) who will post final go/no-go?
Jonathan: we can canary 5% for 15m after ingest completes. I'll post go/no-go in this thread at +20m.
Lee: If canary looks good, I'll do alias swap and mark completion. If anything looks off, I will execute rollback.
Maria: tagging stakeholders: @Nidhi (monitor), @Lee (rollback), @Jonathan (smoke/canary). Please reply with :thumbsup when you can.
Jonathan: :thumbsup
Lee: :thumbsup
Nidhi: :thumbsup
Maria: thanks all. small note for ops: keep the rollback command handy and don't run anything else that touches the catalog in the slot window.
sre-bot: Reminder: On-call rotation for 2025-06-02 02:30-05:00 UTC: Lee (primary), Ops (secondary).
Maria: final: I'll start the ingest 02:50 UTC with a dry-run, then proceed to full ingest at 03:00 if dry-run OK. Watch the thread for go/no-go.
Jonathan: I'll post the smoke results here (~03:20 UTC).
Lee: ready for rollback if needed.
Nidhi: I'll keep alerts and dashboards open.
Maria: thanks team — see you in the thread at ~03:20.
